name: Speed Tech Corp.
summary: Speed Tech Corp., established in 1990 and headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, is a global company focused on the conceptualization, development, production, and distribution of connectors. These essential components serve a wide array of international sectors including communication, computing, automotive, and general consumer electronics. Their extensive product line features diverse connector types such as USB Type C (receptacle and plug configurations), SAS and slim SAS pin connectors, mini-SAS HD connectors, OCulink connectors, pogo pins, RF switches and coaxial connectors, RJ45 connectors, SMT products, and BTB (board-to-board) receptacles and plugs. Beyond its core connector business, the company participates in reinvestment and trading endeavors. It also undertakes the manufacturing, processing, and trading of numerous other items, including remote control buttons, computer peripherals, data storage devices, various electronic components, and consumer electronic accessories. Furthermore, Speed Tech Corp. produces and markets metal stamped parts, plastic injected components, as well as ferrous and copper products. Its capabilities extend to the research, development, manufacturing, and sale of electrical wires, cables, connecting lines, additional computer peripherals, precision molds (encompassing die, jig, and plastic molding types), and plastic hardware. The company also acts as a supplier of printed circuit boards (PCBs).
